description: This file defines a set of classes and methods for converting between various numeric types and strings, including parsing, formatting, and type casting functionalities. It includes specific converter classes such as BigDecimalToString, StringToBigInteger, and generic converters for types like Double, Float, Integer, Long, Short, Byte, BigDecimal, and BigInteger.

classes.name: NumberConverters
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading and registering various number conversion utilities.

classes.name: AbstractStringToNumberConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting strings to numeric types, handling locale-specific parsing.

classes.name: AbstractNumberConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting between generic source and target types with localization support.

classes.name: AbstractNumberToStringConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting numeric types to their string representation.

classes.name: GenericNumberToDouble
classes.description: Converter that casts various Number types to Double.

classes.name: GenericNumberToFloat
classes.description: Converter that casts various Number types to Float.

classes.name: GenericNumberToInteger
classes.description: Converter that casts various Number types to Integer.

classes.name: GenericNumberToLong
classes.description: Converter that casts various Number types to Long.

classes.name: GenericNumberToShort
classes.description: Converter that casts various Number types to Short.
